title: Founders of the Academy
subtitle: Scholars and organizers who launched the Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences

people.name: Huseyn Javid
people.summary: Advocated for cultural and scientific institutions that later informed the Academy's mission.
people.bio: Javid's literary and intellectual leadership inspired public support for scientific institutions, creating momentum that culminated in the Academy's founding.

people.name: Mir Movsum Agha Aliyev
people.summary: Coordinated early institutional frameworks that became the Academy.
people.bio: Aliyev bridged governmental support with scholarly needs, helping to secure resources and governance models for the Academy's launch.

people.name: Gara Garayev Sultanov
people.summary: Promoted multidisciplinary collaboration in the Academy's first programs.
people.bio: Sultanov championed collaborative research across physics, chemistry, and humanities, shaping the Academy's interdisciplinary identity.
